'''Ji Liangnian''' ({{zh|s=计亮年|link=no}}; 20 April 1934 – 2 April 2024) was a Chinese chemist who was a professor at [[Sun Yat-sen University]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. 

==Biography==
Ji was born in Shanghai, on 20 April 1934, to Ji Zhuqing ({{zh|s=计竹卿|labels=no}}), a staff member of ''[[The Times]]'' in Shanghai.<ref name="ra">{{cite news |author1=Li Yuan ({{lang|zh|李苑}}) |url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2024/4/520296.shtm |script-title=zh:无机化学家计亮年院士逝世，享年90岁 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=3 April 2024 |access-date=8 April 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> He was the youngest of 6 children. In July 1937, the [[Lugou Bridge Incident]] broke out, and the following month, the [[Imperial Japanese Army]] occupied Shanghai, causing his father to lose his job and the family's life to become difficult. In 1940, by the age of 6, his mother died of [[tuberculosis]]; three years later, his father also died of tuberculosis.

In 1948, he began working as an apprentice at a leather goods workshop to make a living. After the [[Shanghai Campaign|liberation of Shanghai]] in May 1949, he completed middle and high school courses with a work-study program. In 1952, he enrolled at [[Shandong University]], where he majored in the Department of Chemistry.<ref name="ra"/> After graduating in 1956, he studied in the Radiochemistry Research Class of the Department of Technology at [[Peking University]], serving as a teaching assistant and visiting scholar.<ref name="ra"/> In September 1959, he went to the Chemistry Research Class of the Department of Chemistry at [[Nanjing University]] for further studies, under the guidance of Prof. {{ill|Dai Anbang|zh|戴安邦}} and Soviet expert Savage. 

He became a lecturer at {{ill|Hengyang Mining and Metallurgical Engineering Institute|zh|衡阳矿冶学院}} in September 1960 before being assigned to the similar position in Guangdong Institute of Mining and Metallurgy (now [[Guangdong University of Technology]]) in September 1972.<ref name="re">{{cite news |author1=Ouyang Lingya ({{lang|zh|欧阳伶亚}}) |url=https://www.hunantoday.cn/news/xhn/202404/19717212.html |script-title=zh:送别！无机化学家计亮年院士逝世 |work=hunantoday.cn |date=5 April 2024 |access-date=8 April 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> In November 1975, he was recruited as a lecturer at [[Sun Yat-sen University]], where he was promoted to full professor in 1986 and dean of the School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering in 1994.<ref name="ra"/> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) in January 1981.<ref name="re"/><ref name="rc">{{cite news |url=https://www.sohu.com/a/769307049_120333600 |script-title=zh:送别！无机化学家计亮年院士逝世  |work=Sohu |date=5 April 2024 |access-date=8 April 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1982, he became a visiting scholar at [[Northwestern University]] in the United States.<ref name="ra"/> He retired in October 2018.<ref name="re"/>

On 2 April 2024, he died from an illness in [[Guangzhou]], Guangdong, at the age of 89.<ref name="rc"/>

== Contributions ==
In 1982, during Ji's visit to Northwestern University in the United States, he first discovered the "indene dynamic effect" internationally and was hailed as one of the three contributors to the discovery.<ref name="re"/><ref name="rb">{{cite news |author1=Chen Xiaoyi ({{lang|zh|陈晓怡}}) |url=http://news.cnnb.com.cn/system/2024/04/05/030576750.shtml |script-title=zh:痛悼！甬籍院士计亮年逝世 |work=cnnb.com.cn |date=5 April 2024 |access-date=8 April 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 1989 Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] (RSC)<ref name="rb"/>
* 2003 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="ra"/>
